source.title: 수소충전소 계량 정확도 향상을 위한 거래량 산출 모델 연구
source.institutional_context: Korea Gas Safety Corporation-linked hydrogen station metering experiment
source.retrieval: public article HTML inspected; no downloadable raw logger archive found

observed_experiment.scope: component-level tube-trailer hydrogen supply and transaction-volume metering

finding: The public article supplies provenance, instrumentation scope, sampling rate and reported error summaries for a real component experiment, but it does not publish synchronized row-level pressure-temperature-mass-flow files with station/controller state and reuse terms.
use: Independent component-level metering evidence and a high-priority request lead; it may support face-validity discussion but must not be scored as an untouched full-loop digital-twin holdout.
requested_package: units, clock definition, quality flags and missing-value rules
written permission for derived metrics and journal publication
claim_boundary: Do not claim full-station validation from this component study. A raw, synchronized package must be quarantined, hashed and frozen before numerical outcomes are opened or used in an IJHE submission.
